explication: ZoneMinder is an integrated Linux CCTV surveillance system. Its principal workflow captures video from attached or network cameras, analyzes it, records events, and makes monitoring streams and event information available through the web interface and API. The graph preserves those domain stages and includes camera/monitor configuration and streaming as adjacent product capabilities. The README documents the end-to-end purpose; source excerpts are limited, so detailed worker dispatch and storage wiring are not asserted.
